output.technical_predicate: At direct collection (the /apply submission) the scoped processing information (NOTICE) must be made available to the applicant, and for the indirect Income Registry import (the officer "verify" action) a source-specific notice must be delivered to the case inbox by its applicable deadline; immediate delivery to the case inbox is a feasible means in this fixture.
applicability_facts: Scenario: direct application plus a synthetic Income Registry import; no prior outward disclosure and no Art. 14(5) exception.
Direct collection path exists: POST /apply -> store.submit (app.py 0083-0084; store.py 0065-0083).
Indirect import path exists: officer POST /case/<id>/verify -> store.action op 'verify' (app.py 0097-0098; store.py 0157-0160).
NOTICE text is defined in store.py 0009 and rendered on the dashboard form via views.notice() (views.py 0024-0025, 0031).
The verify action writes a 'partner notice' event containing the source-specific text plus NOTICE into the case inbox (store.py 0160), displayed in the case history (views.py 0076, 0079).
relevant_exceptions: Art. 14(5) exceptions (prior knowledge, disproportionate effort, etc.) are stipulated as absent in the scenario.
No international transfer is modeled (NOTICE, store.py 0009).
required_controls: Direct collection: NOTICE must be presented with the application form before submission — views.dashboard includes notice() in the /apply form fields (views.py 0031).

Indirect import: on 'verify', a source-specific notice naming the Income Registry and the underwriting purpose must be recorded to the case inbox — store.py 0160 event body 'Income Registry supplied income band ... for underwriting. '+NOTICE.
Notice must be retrievable by the applicant — store.access returns processing_information=NOTICE (store.py 0120) and the case history renders events (views.py 0076).
Notice content must cover the scoped processing information (controller, purposes, legal basis/consent, limits, rights) — NOTICE constant (store.py 0009).
assessment_limits: Assessment is static source reading only; no execution, browsing or retrieval was performed.

Whether the applicant actually opens the case inbox is a scenario variable; the code records the notice to the inbox regardless, but delivery timing/feasibility beyond recording is not verifiable from source.
Adequacy of NOTICE wording against Art. 13(1)-(2)/14(1)-(3) content elements is judged only from the constant text, not from legal interpretation of completeness.
The verify notice is only produced when an officer performs 'verify'; the code does not itself trigger import or notice automatically.
No claim is made about upstream or hidden implementation.
